name: Chime Fingerhole
description: Study an armored foe's plate overlaps to find the seams that a thrown ring can reach.

name: Gustbounce
description: Turn the hips through the throw so the full weight of the body drives the ring at armor.

name: Vessel Ringface
description: Rest the ring's rim along the forearm and take a blade on the ring's broad flat.

name: Meridian Hoopedge
description: Close the gap by a half step on the throwing side just as the ring leaves the hand.

name: Facet Outerblade
description: Aim at the gap under a pauldron so the ring's edge slips between plates and bites.

name: Skinning Innergrip
description: Skim the ring along the plane of the chest so it rides up under the gorget.

name: Facet Bladering
description: Feed qi into a heavy throw so the whirling rim grinds through a layer of plate before it stops.

name: Diskbarrage
description: Cut a seam wide with the rim at close range then fling the ring away through the opening.

name: Daybreak Fingerhole
description: Set the wrist at an angle before the throw to decide which way the ring will bend.

name: Meridian Roundedge
description: Lean the body away from the target as you throw so the ring bends back across the line.

name: Torrent Outerblade
description: Angle the wrist cuff to turn a thrown dart aside as the arm comes down.

name: Diskleap
description: Cross the feet lightly and open the hips to set the angle for a bending throw.

name: Hoopassault
description: Throw wide so the ring flies a bow-shaped arc and strikes from the side the target faces away from.

name: Vessel Spinrim
description: Tilt the ring so it climbs and curls over a raised shield before dropping on the shoulder.

name: Vessel Carom
description: Throw so the ring curves out past the target and swings back to cut the exposed back.

name: Needling Holeedge
description: Cast the ring in a looping arc that bends after a dodging foe and strikes where he stops.

name: Cleaving Bounce
description: Spiral the ring above a hedge of raised spears so it plunges onto the body behind them.

name: Restoring Hoopedge
description: Keep a silent count of the rings left on the arm so none is thrown to an empty hand.

name: Chimegraze
description: Fan three rings off the forearm in one sweep at three different heights.

name: Vigorous Innergrip
description: Draw from the stack in an even beat so each ring is spun up before it is loosed.

name: Grazejaunt
description: Throw while backing away in short paces so the thrower stays out of the foe's reach.

name: Iron Bladering
description: Raise the ring-laden forearm across the face and let the stacked rims take the blow.

name: Granite Holeedge
description: Throw rings one after another at a single spot to keep a foe pinned behind cover.

name: Splintering Carom
description: Fan rings in a wide spread so a clustered group of foes must all give ground.

name: Severing Graze
description: Release a counted chain of rings that each strike where the one before it drew the guard.

name: Siltcarom
description: Fill the air around you with qi and loose a storm of rings across it at a crowded front.

name: Unyielding Disk
description: Keep several rings whirling about the body in overlapping orbits to turn aside arrows and thrown blades.

name: Spinrim Elixir
description: Drive a spinning ring with a steady push of the finger so its speed never sags.

name: Blazecarom
description: Let the ring leave the hand slowly but spinning hard so it bites longer on contact.

name: Remnant Disk
description: Touch the rim to feel the heat built by long spinning and know when the ring is ready.

name: Bounding Ringface
description: Skip lightly sideways on the toes so the spinning ring is never jarred.

name: Iron Ricochet
description: Hold the whirling ring against an enemy blade so its edge saws at the steel.

name: Scalding Hoopedge
description: Feed qi into the spin throughout the flight so the ring keeps its cutting speed to the end.

name: Resilient Spinrim
description: Carry a spinning ring before the chest so blows meet the rim and glance off.

name: Gust Innergrip
description: Keep a whirling ring cutting through one foe after another without letting its speed drop.

name: Grazecuirass
description: Spin the ring through a foe's raised arms so its rim catches cloth and draws the limbs together.

name: Daybreak Bladering
description: Pair two rings on the two wrists so each hand knows the weight of the other.

name: Fortifying Roundedge
description: Fix the eyes on one point like a hawk and let the mind follow the second ring unaided.

name: Harrowing Graze
description: Throw two rings from two hands along two separate tracks toward one target.

name: Iron Fingerhole
description: Stand open and square with the rings low and crossed to cover the body from both sides.

name: Roundpounce
description: Step off with both feet in a matched pair so the shoulders stay level for the twin throw.

name: Skinning Whirlcut
description: Throw two rings that bend apart like a river round a stone and close again on the target.

name: Transfixing Graze
description: Draw both rings together into the basin of the palms and throw them out as one.

name: Intentround
description: Release one ring and send its twin a breath behind so each throw seems the echo of the other.

name: Unmaking Gyrate
description: Dive in with both rings crossed at the front so the paired rims strike together like a hawk's talons.

name: Stalwart Disk
description: Cross both rings in a scissoring guard that catches a heavy blow between the rims and bends it away.

name: Waning Outerblade
description: Let the gaze circle the foe slowly as a hawk's does until the open line shows itself.

name: Vital Fingerhole
description: Draw one ring with each hand in the same instant and the same line like a reflection.

name: Facetgraze
description: Skim two flat rings low and level in parallel so they strike together.

name: Furrowing Ricochet
description: Lob one ring high into the open sky so it drops from above while the other flies low.

name: Unbroken Spinrim
description: Cross the wrists before the face and take a downward blow on the two rims.

name: Nimbuscarom
description: Slip sideways along the lip of the stance as if on a basin's edge and then turn back square.

name: Gust Ringface
description: Throw both rings in opposite curves so they circle the target and return to the thrower.

name: Hoarfrost Bounce
description: Send two rings down two forking tracks so a retreating foe is cut off on both sides.

name: Gust Disk
description: Meet a blade between both rims at once and scissor it sideways out of line.

name: Bounce Leap
description: Glide low and swift at the target as the twin rings sweep wide to close the gap with the throw.

name: Thornhoop
description: Weave the two rings in opposite orbits about a foe so their rims cross his limbs and draw him tight.

name: Glintbounce
description: Strike from both sides at once with ring edges and qi so the pincer cuts through a guarded body.

name: Equipoise Roundedge
description: Breathe in the slow even pace of a river so the arms stay loose through long throwing.

name: Vital Bladering
description: Settle the feet wide and the weight low like the floor of a basin to hold the body steady.

name: Bouncethrash
description: Skim two rings along parallel lines a hand's breadth apart so the target cannot slip between.

name: Scything Holeedge
description: Lob a ring from the stance's near side so it falls on the far bank of the foe's guard.

name: Soaring Graze
description: Dodge between two paces as water slips between stones in a riverbed.

name: Aura Holeedge
description: Bend the body away from a blow like a reed while the ring covers the line behind it.

name: Gyratethrash
description: Throw a second ring along the first's path so it follows like a boat on a current.

name: Granite Bounce
description: Turn the held ring in a short eddy at the foe's wrist to cut the grip loose.

name: Caromassault
description: Loose both rings in a rush toward a defended spot so the foe must give way.

name: Blazegyrate
description: Gather qi in both palms until it overflows then pour paired rings across the front in a wide sheet.

name: Glintround
description: Drive a pair of rings along one line like a river cutting through a bank to open the rank.

name: Intent Outerblade
description: Take a loose grip that lets the ring feel the wind through the hand without slipping.

name: Facethoop
description: Take a bearing on the mark and hold it through the throw until the ring has left the hand.

name: Aegis Roundedge
description: Stand square and open as on a bare plateau with no cover behind and the ring held ready.

name: Siltgraze
description: Lean into a strong gust and let it carry the first step forward.

name: Scything Carom
description: Throw wide of the mark into a crosswind and let the wind carry the ring onto it.

name: Blaze Fingerhole
description: Throw so the ring curves home to the hand as a kept oath returns to the one who swore it.

name: Cleaving Ricochet
description: Step into the wind and cut with the ring's edge so the gust adds its push to the stroke.

name: Raging Innergrip
description: Whirl the ring to the pitch of the gale so the wind itself keeps it spinning past its usual reach.

name: Chime Bladering
description: Keep rings turning wide on both sides so a strike from any direction meets a rim.

name: Nursing Disk
description: Set the feet as if on a plateau's brink so every shift of weight is deliberate.

name: Remnant Innergrip
description: Sight along the ring's edge to a far mark and hold that line in the mind.

name: Furrowing Hoopedge
description: Speak a counted oath under the breath and throw the ring on the last number.

name: Charter Holeedge
description: Turn the shoulder into the wind and ring-guarded arm across it to take a blow in the gust.

name: Vaulting Ringface
description: Hop at the crest of a gust so the rising air lightens the step.

name: Facetgyrate
description: Hold the bearing across a great distance so the ring flies true over open plateau.

name: Wrecking Gyrate
description: Release the ring into a rising gust so it climbs and then drops steeply on the mark.

name: Gust Spinrim
description: Turn the ring's rim into a blade with the wind behind it to sweep the blade aside.

name: Trouncing Hoopedge
description: Hold one bearing and throw a rapid string of rings down it so the line is closed to the foe.

name: Transfixing Carom
description: Gather qi and the wind's push into one great sweeping throw that cuts across an open front.

name: Anointing Hoopedge
description: Carry the ring on an open palm so it is ready to spin up without a regrip.

name: Meridian Gyrate
description: Pitch the ring on the sworn line with no flourish and no second thought.

name: Meridian Spinrim
description: Brace the feet and set the ring-guarded arm to meet a charge without giving ground.

name: Bounding Roundedge
description: Break into a run from the open stance in one stride with the ring hand held back.

name: Scorching Graze
description: Throw dead straight and never bend the line while trusting the sworn bearing over any trick.

name: Rumble Holeedge
description: Cut backhand with the ring as the wind pushes at the shoulder and quickens the stroke.

name: Tearing Roundedge
description: Hold the target on one bearing and throw at point-blank range so the edge punches through a raised guard.

name: Mightround
description: Rush across open ground with the wind behind and cut through the foe's line with the ring in hand.
